title: Switch between main app sections
description: This test verifies that a user can move between the main sections of the app from the home shell and see each section load.

steps.description: Verify the dashboard section is displayed
Verify the calendar section is displayed
Verify the assistant section is displayed
Verify the settings section is displayed

steps.description: Verify free time slots are displayed

Verify prayer times on the timeline are updated
Verify prayer blocks are displayed on the timeline

title: Adjust prayer durations and see prayer blocks resize

steps.description: Adjust the duration for one prayer within the allowed range

title: Start creating a task from a free slot

steps.description: Verify the task creation sheet opens
Verify the selected time range is prefilled

title: Delete a dashboard task and see the timeline update
description: This test verifies that a user can remove an existing task from the dashboard and see it disappear from the timeline.

steps.description: Select an existing task in the timeline
Verify the task is no longer displayed in the timeline

Fill in the task description field with Review Islamic history notes

Select an end time that overlaps the existing task
Verify the schedule updates to reflect the chosen conflict resolution
